prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1116; do not mention it.)
text:
This letter confirms that our firm now represents our client in connection with the rear-end collision in which they were injured. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office, and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or electronic means.

We ask that you provide the bodily injury and property damage liability limits of the policy issued to your insured, along with a certified copy of the declarations page and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. Please also confirm the claim number assigned to this loss and the name of the adjuster handling the file.

We further request that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, dash camera or telematics data, recorded statements, claim notes, repair estimates, vehicle inspection reports, and any other materials in your possession, custody, or control. Failure to preserve such evidence may result in serious consequences in any later proceeding.

Please acknowledge receipt of this letter and provide the requested information within fifteen days. We look forward to your prompt response.
